name: Key Packaging Co
old_description: YOUR KEY PARTNER FOR CUSTOM INNOVATIVE THERMOFORMING SOLUTIONS
about:
Key Packaging Co operates from Sarasota, Florida, providing custom thin-gauge thermoforming solutions for plastic packaging. The company offers integrated design, prototyping, mold building, and thermoforming services under one roof.

Its manufacturing capabilities include design and prototyping, mold and tool building, thermoforming production, supply chain management, and quality assurance. The company produces a variety of packaging products such as protective and shipping trays for automotive and industrial components, medical device packaging, pharmaceutical packaging, cosmetic packaging, retail packaging, electronic packaging, and food packaging.

Key Packaging serves customers in the medical, automotive, pharmaceutical, cosmetic, retail, electronics, and food industries. Specific applications include medical device trays, automotive component shipping trays, and consumer product packaging for retail and cosmetic markets.

The company differentiates itself through a corporate commitment to Lean Six Sigma methodology, employing both Black Belt and Green Belt personnel to drive process excellence. It holds ISO 9001:2015 certification and operates a ship-to-stock program that allows qualified customers to receive products without incoming inspection.

name: Key Woodworking, Inc.
old_description: Keywood has been serving the DMV area projects since 1992 with passion.
about:
Key Woodworking, Inc., based in Springfield, Virginia, was founded in 1992 by a first-generation immigrant who began as a one-man woodworking shop. The company remains a small business serving the Washington, D.C. metro area.

The firm specializes in custom-fabricated premium architectural woodwork for commercial projects, with a focus on upscale high-rise multi-residential buildings and Class A office towers. It provides engineering services to align design intent with fabrication, and sources wood products globally from Europe, Africa, and Asia. The shop has executed single contracts exceeding $2 million under tight deadlines.

Key Woodworking serves designers, contractors, and owners in sectors including multi-residential construction, office construction, restaurants, and public institutions. Its project portfolio includes amenity spaces, lobbies, and lounges throughout the DMV region.

The company emphasizes values of honesty, hard work, and innovation, citing pride in dedication, finely tuned scheduling, open communication, project ownership, and innovative solutions as differentiators.

name: Keyser Manufacturing
old_description: OMI specializes in quality aftermarket ATV parts and accessories. ATVs are designed to be tough, but even the best made ride occasionally needs routine maintenance, an upgrade or a replacement part. OMI offers a great selection of products created to keep up with those hard driving off-road track or trail adventures. For aftermarket ATV parts and accessories shop … OMI ATV Products!
about:
Keyser Manufacturing operates from Coopersville, Michigan. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed. It markets aftermarket ATV parts and accessories under the OMI brand while also providing contract fabrication services for a range of industries.

The shop offers a broad suite of metalworking processes: CNC machining (lathes and mills), laser cutting (Mitsubishi 2D LP Plus II, 3,500-watt CO2, 60"×120" bed, ±0.00039" repeatability), waterjet cutting (6" thick, 6'×12' sheets), turret punching (Strippit 1000/20, 20-station), rolling and forming, robotic and manual welding (MIG, TIG), powder coating, and anodizing. It also runs 3D printing for rapid prototypes and develops shock absorbers for racing applications. The company states it can handle everything from single-piece prototypes to production runs of thousands, and lists over 12,000 stocked product SKUs.

Customers span automotive, tool and die, chemical, transportation, craft production, industrial equipment, shipping, and government sectors. The OMI line targets off-road and ATV enthusiasts with shocks, cooling components, body parts, and suspension components.

Keyser emphasizes in-house control of every process, quick turnaround on quotes and production, and a willingness to quote jobs other shops decline. Its engineering team supports design and CAD file import directly into production software.

name: Keystone Electrical Manufacturing Company
old_description: Since 1964, the Keystone team has fine-tuned its expertise in the design and production of power protection and control equipment. As part of Keystone’s services, we’ll manage your control system manufacturing process and ensure all design requirements are met – precisely and cost-effectively.
about:
Keystone Electrical Manufacturing Company has operated from Des Moines, Iowa since its founding in 1964. The company began as a manufacturer serving the electrical power sector and has remained independently owned, though the ownership structure is not publicly detailed.

The company designs and produces power protection and control equipment, including custom control panels, substation control centers, power distribution centers, and medium-voltage switchgear. A vertically integrated facility handles sheet metal fabrication, assembly, wiring, and testing in-house. Engineering support, single-point project management, and detailed documentation — from panel layouts and schematics to as-built records — are provided alongside manufacturing.

Keystone serves electrical generation, transmission, and distribution utilities, as well as OEM partners in renewable energy such as wind turbine, transformer, and breaker manufacturers. Its low-voltage control panels are used in voltage regulation systems and industrial machinery. The company also assembles DC battery systems and installs utility services like HVAC, lighting, and security within control buildings.

Keystone emphasizes its vertically integrated workflow, dedicated project managers, and rigorous testing program. Every product undergoes in-process and final testing using a Doble F6150e test set, a Peschel 100 kV Hi-Pot, and a custom breaker simulator, with procedures aligned to IEEE/ANSI standards. Customers are invited to visit the facility for inspections and witness testing.

name: Ki USA Corporation
old_description: Our goal is to be a world class organization; through teamwork and communication, success is our future.  We specialize in manufacturing custom automotive parts and components for notable customers like Honda, Mazda, and Ford.  Our advanced metal stamping, electro-coat painting, and welding processes enable us to create the perfect solution for your company's needs.
about:
Ki USA Corporation has operated from Berea, Kentucky since its production start-up in August 1989. The company is a subsidiary of American Industrial Acquisition Corporation and began as a manufacturer of automotive engine, body, and suspension components.

The company specializes in precision metal stamping, robotic welding, and electro-deposition (e-coat) finishing, all housed in a 250,000-square-foot facility on 54 acres. The vertically integrated platform combines advanced metal stamping, programmable robotic welding systems, automated material handling, and an in-house e-coat line. The Berea site employs 160 associates, while a subsidiary in Irapuato, Guanajuato, Mexico, added in June 2015, employs 45 and provides localized support for Mexican customers.

Ki USA serves the automotive sector — including internal combustion, hybrid, and electric vehicle markets — with customers such as Honda, Mazda, and Ford. Its product portfolio includes engine mounts, brake boosters, engine oil pans, and other critical components. The company is also expanding into power generation and home appliance sectors.

Ki USA emphasizes trust, transparency, and community engagement as foundations of its culture. It cites its vertically integrated approach, extensive automation, and in-house e-coat process as differentiators that enable cost-competitive, high-quality solutions with faster turnaround. The company also highlights its commitment to continuous improvement, associate empowerment, and charitable initiatives such as Relay For Life and Soles4Souls.

name: Kibberia Fresh Foods
old_description: Commercial kitchen offering over 350 products from around the world!
about:
Kibberia Foods operates commercial kitchens in Danbury, Connecticut, and Lafayette, Louisiana. The company traces its roots to a restaurant opened in Danbury by founder Carole Iskandar and her husband Sam more than ten years ago, and it remains family owned and operated. In 2021, the business expanded to Lafayette to serve retailers in the Southeast.

The facilities produce more than 350 recipes and maintain an established line of over 250 SKUs, ranging from individual portions to food-service packaging. All ingredients are received and processed on the same day, and products are made fresh to order. The kitchens are certified under SQF, HACCP, and FSMA standards, with USDA inspection on site.

Kibberia Foods supplies large retailers and supermarkets, primarily in the Northeast and Southeast regions. Its customer base includes supermarket chains that carry the company's all-natural, prepared foods under their own brands or the Kibberia label.

The company emphasizes a boutique approach to recipe development, offering rapid turnaround from concept to mass production in as little as one week. It also highlights flexibility in pricing, packaging, and seasonal adjustments, and donates surplus food to local charities.

about:
Killdeer Mountain Manufacturing, Inc. was founded in 1987 in Killdeer, North Dakota. The company maintains additional offices in Dickinson, Kerrville, Texas, Fargo, and Bismarck, North Dakota. Ownership structure and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company produces cable assemblies, electrical wire harnesses, and fiber optic bundles for demanding applications. Its manufacturing capabilities encompass electrical wire harness assembly and fiber optic technology, including work to ARINC 807 aerospace standards. Operations span multiple facilities across North Dakota and Texas, though specific facility sizes, headcount, and annual volumes are not published.

KMM serves aerospace, military, and commercial aviation customers. Referenced programs include Boeing Wichita's 767-GTTA, Lockheed Martin's U-2, Seyers, and Southwest. The company holds terms agreements with Boeing Military, Boeing Commercial, and Lockheed Martin, indicating established supply relationships with major defense and aerospace primes.

name: Kindel Furniture Company
old_description: Kindel Grand Rapids creates made-to-order furniture that bears your signature style.
about:
Kindel Furniture Company traces its roots to 1886 when Albert F. Karges, a first-generation immigrant, invested $600 to begin making moderately priced American-style furniture from local hardwoods in Evansville, Indiana. Charles J. Kindel founded the Kindel Furniture Company in 1901. In 1964, John Fisher of Muncie, Indiana, purchased Kindel, and the Fisher family has maintained family ownership for over 50 years. The current entity, Kindel Grand Rapids, was formed when Kindel Furniture acquired the Karges and Councill Furniture companies, bringing together over 300 years of collective experience. The company is headquartered in Wyoming, Michigan, in the Grand Rapids area.

Kindel Grand Rapids produces made-to-order, handcrafted luxury furniture from its Grand Rapids facility. The product range spans dining, occasional, bedroom, and workspace categories, offered in styles including Timeless, Mid-Century Modern, Urban Modern, Transitional, Hollywood Glam, Organic, Coastal, Minimalist, Bohemian, and Industrial. Each piece is crafted to the precise specifications of the customer, emphasizing American craftsmanship and domestic production.

The company serves the luxury residential and commercial office furniture markets, working with interior designers and clients seeking signature, American-made pieces. Its workspace collections, marketed as defying office expectations, include desks, tables, credenzas, and components for traditional and transitional offices.

Kindel differentiates itself by championing a standard for domestic work while other companies have pursued lower-cost offshore production. The firm’s commitment to 100% American-made furniture and the preservation of a multi-generational craftsmanship heritage underpins its positioning.

about:
King's Wood Creation operates from a facility on West Rose Garden Lane in Phoenix, Arizona. The business traces its roots back more than twenty years to a one-person shop that gradually expanded into a full-scale woodworking operation.

The company produces a range of custom wood products including kitchen and bathroom cabinetry, fireplace mantels, ceiling box beams, furniture, hand railing, and architectural carvings. Production relies on CNC machinery alongside hand-finishing techniques, allowing the shop to handle both standard and highly specialized timber selections. The facility also sources specialty wood species on request.

Its customer base spans building professionals such as contractors and designers as well as individual homeowners seeking bespoke cabinetry and millwork. Projects have included complete kitchen remodels, custom bathroom vanities, and one-off furniture pieces for residential and light commercial settings.

The firm emphasizes its ability to translate a client's vision into a rendered design before fabrication begins, and it promotes a "dream it, we create it" philosophy backed by a ROC contractor license (#340054).

old_description: Our charcoal has been proudly made in the USA since 1920. Available in a variety of flavors to give you a delicious, smoky taste for any occasion.
about:
Kingsford Manufacturing Company operates from Parsons, West Virginia, where it has produced charcoal since 1920. The business emphasizes that its charcoal has been proudly made in the United States since its founding year. No founder names or ownership structure are disclosed in the available information.

The company manufactures a range of charcoal briquets and wood pellets for grilling. Product lines include Original, Professional, Mesquite, Match Light instant-light briquets, and the Easy Light Bag single-use format. Pellets are marketed as a premium-flavor option for pellet grills. The homepage does not provide facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures.

Kingsford’s products target consumer grilling occasions — tailgates, backyard barbecues, seafood cookouts, and everyday meals. The brand positions itself for home cooks and outdoor enthusiasts through retail channels, offering recipes and how-to guides alongside the fuel. No industrial or commercial customers are identified in the source material.

The company highlights its long-standing domestic production and flavor variety as differentiators. The Easy Light Bag is designed for fast, portable lighting, while the pellet line promises premium flavor without a premium price. Match Light briquets eliminate the need for lighter fluid. These claims constitute the stated value proposition.
